messages.en:
{07 14 00}Nothing's more stylish than
wearing flowers on your
head!
{06 01 00 03 04 05}

{07 00 00}I've been thinkin' about
filling my room with the
flowers I grow.
{07 14 00}It'd be like sleeping in
a field of wildflowers!{01 00 00 05 00}
But without all the bugs.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma olen mõelnud, et täidan
oma toa lilledega,
mida kasvatan.
{07 14 00}See oleks nagu magamine
metsalillede väljal!{01 00 00 05 00}
Aga ilma putukateta.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So until recently, I've only
been planting the same
color of flower together.
But then I accidentally
planted a different color
next to 'em!
{07 06 00}Then, this crazy-
colored flower bloomed
nearby!
{07 0a 00}That couldn't have been
just a coincidence, right?
I wonder, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuni hiljutise ajani
istutasin ma kokku ainult
sama värvi lilli.
Aga siis istutasin kogemata
nende kõrvale teist
värvi!
{07 06 00}Ja siis õitses lähedal
üks hullu värviga
lill!
{07 0a 00}See ei saanud olla lihtsalt
juhus, eks?
Huvitav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}That's why I want to grow
amazing flowers for
{04 01 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

If I do that, then can I be
like a gorgeous flower
goddess?
{07 02 00}What if I already am one
and I don't understand my
supernatural flower powers?
messages.et:
Kui ma seda teen, kas siis
saan olla nagu uhke
lillejumalanna?
{07 02 00}Mis siis, kui ma juba olengi
ja ei mõista oma
üleloomulikke lillevägesid?
